items.adjudicator_grounds: Re-derived on both sides of the Isa.26.6|Isa.26.7 seam. The row's last two verses are third-person description of God's act: כִּ֤י הֵשַׁח֙ יֹשְׁבֵ֣י מָר֔וֹם (oshb:Isa.26.5, byte tier) with יַשְׁפִּילֶ֤נָּה יַשְׁפִּילָהּ֙ (oshb:Isa.26.5, byte tier), then תִּרְמְסֶ֖נָּה רָ֑גֶל (oshb:Isa.26.6, byte tier), “The foot shall tread it down” (web:Isa.26.6). Inside the span, second-person address to Yahweh stands exactly once, תִּצֹּ֖ר שָׁל֣וֹם שָׁל֑וֹם כִּ֥י בְךָ֖ בָּטֽוּחַ (oshb:Isa.26.3, byte tier): 26.1 is third person, פִּתְח֖וּ שְׁעָרִ֑ים (oshb:Isa.26.2, byte tier) and בִּטְח֥וּ בַֽיהוָ֖ה (oshb:Isa.26.4, byte tier) are imperatives to human addressees with Yahweh in third-person reference, and 26.5-26.6 are third person. Past the seam the second-person register to Yahweh resumes at once: after the nominal colon אֹ֥רַח לַצַּדִּ֖יק מֵֽישָׁרִ֑ים (oshb:Isa.26.7, byte tier), the same verse turns to יָשָׁ֕ר מַעְגַּ֥ל צַדִּ֖יק תְּפַלֵּֽס (oshb:Isa.26.7, byte tier), “You who are upright make the path of the righteous level.” (web:Isa.26.7), then אַ֣ף אֹ֧רַח מִשְׁפָּטֶ֛יךָ יְהוָ֖ה קִוִּינ֑וּךָ (oshb:Isa.26.8, byte tier) with the divine name vocative. The stated closing-edge driver — a turn from the song's second-person address of Yahweh to a third-person maxim — is byte-false in direction on both sides of the seam, and it recurs verbatim in strongest_rejected_alternative; only the gnomic nominal register of 26.7's first colon survives in the bytes.
